title: Durable record acknowledgment and form draft preservation
finding: App marked a record accepted and put it in session search before authenticated saveRecord resolved. An API failure left an apparently prepared record even though no durable acknowledgement existed; Forms closed the draft before awaiting the caller.
source_changes: An authenticated record is displayed as durable only after matching API record_id acknowledgement.
Hosted Tower session without connected authenticated repository fails closed; it does not silently downgrade to session-only.
Forms waits for App acceptance, retains the draft and shows a retry message on denied or ambiguous save.
Duplicate in-flight record_id submissions are suppressed; validation and duplicate checks remain.
Late saves from a changed Tower actor/business cannot enter the new view.
Hydration reconciles accepted in-memory records so an old search response cannot erase a newly acknowledged save.
Session-only DEV mode remains distinct; hosted recovery cannot replace durable records from a browser snapshot.

current_render_observation.note: Read-only Render inspection, no configuration or deployment changes
